title: AssetUrlIngestRequested
description: An address somebody wants fetched and read. The address is not here: the job already names the asset and where it points, and the pipeline reads it from there. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

job_id.description: The job that names the asset and the address to fetch.
